title: elsholtzia eriostachya var. pusilla
intro: Elsholtzia eriostachya var. pusilla, commonly known as  the Dwarf Vietnamese Sweet Basil, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to Vietnam. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include relieving headaches, fever, and respiratory issues, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal effects. The plant's health benefits include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
